info.text:
Many dental plans still cap coverage at a 40-year-old number.

The annual maximum is the most your plan pays in a year. The ADA (Dec 2025) says many plans still use a $1,000 max set some 40 years ago.
Our math with BLS dental price data: $1,000 of dental care in Dec 1985 cost $5,385 in Dec 2025.
The familiar design pays 100% preventive, 80% basic, 50% major, and some plans add waits (often 6 months basic, 12 months major).
Our example: a $1,400 crown at 50% = $700 from the plan, but with only $500 of a $1,500 max left, you pay $900. An ADA HPI analysis (2024) found only 3.4% of patients reach the typical max. Many plans reset Jan 1.

Sources: ADA News (Dec 19, 2025); ADA Health Policy Institute (2024); BLS CPI dental services; Delta Dental; Guardian; Humana; example math by FinancePros TV.
News and education, not financial advice.
